description: Bedeutungsräume für den Fußverkehr is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Der Datensatz enthält die Bedeutungsräume für den Fußverkehr in Hamburg. Sie sollen die Relevanz von Wegen und Straßen für Zufußgehende visualisieren.Die Daten wurden auf Basis eines Fußwegenetz aus dem Digitalen Landschaftsmodell und verschiedenen Interessensorten (POI) wie ÖPNV-Haltestellen, Einzelhandel oder Schulen berechnet. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are fußgänger, fußverkehr, geodaten, transparenzportal-hamburg, wege. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
